$comment: English texts of data/portals.json (src/engine/portals.js): the System Portals and the sentences of a portal fight's report. Each key keeps the Polish number of variants, as the engine picks one by index. „Stopień” is a stage (Stage 12), so it does not mix with the creatures' levels.

gold.name: Gold Portal
gold.description: A gate to the System's vault. Win to collect gold.

wood.name: Wood Portal
wood.description: A gate to a forest no map shows. Win to collect wood.

stone.name: Stone Portal
stone.description: A gate to the System's quarry. Win to collect stone.

ore.name: Ore Portal
ore.description: A gate to deep mine shafts. Win to collect iron ore.

materials.name: Material Portal
materials.description: A gate to the creatures' lairs. Win to collect the materials of the stage's creatures.

parts.name: Parts Portal
parts.description: A gate to the System's armoury. Win to collect crafting parts.

fightStart: Waiting on the other side of the portal: {enemies}.
defeat: The System leads {target} out of the portal.
